summary: First full test iteration for EtherAuthority Interns MVP (Express + Prisma + React/Vite). All 33 backend pytest tests pass (health, auth, games/dapps public+CRUD+workflow, blogs public+CRUD, search, admin/stats, contact, newsletter, upload single+multiple). All 17 frontend UI flows pass via Playwright (home, hero navigation, game details + like button, blog listing, search page, contact form submission, /admin protected route redirect, admin login+dashboard, admin games list rows, admin action buttons approve/reject/feature/rank/edit/delete, new game form, new blog form with TipTap editor, blog category names visible, footer newsletter subscribe with success toast).

issues: React Router v6 future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) appear in console. Not breaking but noisy - can be silenced by opting in via future flags on the router.

critical_code_review_comments: server.js uses `cors({ origin: true, credentials: true })` which reflects the request origin. Since auth uses stateless JWT in Authorization header (not cookies), this is fine, but for stricter security consider an explicit allow-list of origins.

projectRouter.js `admin=true` list branch only checks presence of Bearer header, not that the token is valid or admin-role. A garbage token would still return admin data. Consider running full requireAuth+requireAdmin on that branch.
blogs.js has the same weak auth check on admin=true listing.
projectRouter.js /:id/rank uses parseInt(req.body.rank) but the route is not idempotent (no upper bound / uniqueness). Minor.
upload.js filename generation is not cryptographically strong (Date.now + Math.random slice). Fine for demo.
Home.jsx swallows API errors silently (`.catch(() => {})`) - would help debugging to surface a toast.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly in api.js (Vite exposes both REACT_APP_ and VITE_ via vite.config.js define, presumably).
test_credentials: admin@etherauthority.com / Admin@123 (seeded via seedAdmin.js). No /app/memory/test_credentials.md file exists; credentials were provided in review request.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_-prefixed games/blogs via admin API and deletes them at the end of each cycle. Test contact + newsletter submissions are left behind (contact record + subscriber) but do not affect functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is self-contained and idempotent - can be re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. It uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env (falls back to /app/frontend/.env). Admin token is fetched once per session via seeded admin creds. All UI data-testid attributes are consistent with the review request. Frontend uses JWT bearer in localStorage 'ea_token'; ProtectedRoute redirects to /login. No cookies/CSRF layer to worry about. Postgres and demo seed are auto-loaded on backend boot. TipTap editor renders as .ProseMirror in DOM.
